additional_info.subject: 0385819 - ID0385819-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / S2 170003300] Technical Query CRM:00439000699
additional_info.body:
Hallo lorenz
for this topic:
They bought a Payter P66 terminal under the assumption that our cloud integration would work, but that is not the case now. Because when a card is scanned on the terminal we do not know which connector the user wants to load on, we send an OCPP RemoteStartTransaction command without a connectorId. Other charging stations then let the user choose a connector (either by plugging into any available connector, or by letting them choose on the screen), but the last time I tested that on a Siemens Sicharge D, the remote was start denied. Could that be fixed in a future firmware update?
we do not support RemoteStartTransactions without ID this message will therefore be denied from sicharge so this question
"
we send an OCPP RemoteStartTransaction command without a connectorId"  is Ansvered by that we currently work on a solution for FW Versions in future but when this will be implemented or if it wil be implemented there i have no Ansver at current state
BR Semih
